He picks up the instrument, sits down, and begins strumming and singing with a highly animated, comical facial expression. He looks directly at the camera, ending the performance with a satisfied smile as he holds the final pose.

The protagonist excitedly pitches a mundane 'soy milk comparison' idea which is immediately rejected by his cameraman. After a moment of exaggerated despair, he pivots to a musically-driven presentation of the same topic, using a humorous song to make the boring subject engaging and viral-friendly.
